Get More from Your Garden with a Little Chaos

A chaos garden gives you more than just a bigger harvest—it brings more life, more peace, and more surprises.

➡️ What does "more" mean?

🌿 More harvest

Plants grow closer together and are combined more effectively.
Your garden produces more food in the same amount of space.

🥕 More diversity

Instead of one crop per bed, many different species grow together.
This makes your garden richer and more resilient.

🧘 More peace (less work)

Less digging, less raking, less constant intervention.
Your garden does more by itself, while you work less—but more wisely.

🌸 More life

More flowers, more insects, more birds.
Your garden becomes a small ecosystem instead of just a production area.

🌿 More beauty

Not a perfectly tidy field, but a living landscape.
A garden that looks and feels like a piece of nature.

🔍 More discovery

You learn what works and what doesn't.
Every season becomes an experiment.

🎲 More surprises

Plant combinations create unexpected results.
That makes gardening more exciting and dynamic.

🌍 More carbon stored in the soil

More mulch → more organic matter → more carbon stored in the soil and less in the atmosphere.
In this way, your garden also contributes to tackling climate change.

"Getting more from your garden" starts with:

  • 🌱 Building healthy soil
  • 🌿 Increasing biodiversity
  • 🚶 Respecting pathways
  • 🧩 Designing your garden wisely
  • ⚖️ Learning to guide and adjust nature
↑ Chaos Garden
